Hi @siqbal1986 

Which topology do you use?

comments.author: siqbal1986
comments.body:
> Hi @siqbal1986 
> 
> Which topology do you use?

T1

comments.author: ppikh
comments.body:
Hi, @siqbal1986 T1 topo does not have port-channels at all. I think you are using "t1-64-lag" which uses all ports as port-channels.
I will add logic in the test case to skip the test in the case when we do not have "free" ports which are not port-channel members.

comments.author: siqbal1986
comments.body: yes you are correct. its a t1-64-lag
